findings.problem: Generic picture movement conflicts with contiguous EDL semantics.
findings.resolution: Use explicit EDL reorder and bounded positional moves only for timed tracks.

findings.problem: Editor metadata could be mistaken for rendered semantics.
findings.resolution: Validate the editor namespace and add Render Graph digest parity tests.

findings.problem: EventSource cannot send the Studio read header.
findings.resolution: Use the active unguessable editor session plus loopback Host/Origin/no-referrer checks.

findings.problem: Waveform extraction could block or grow without bounds.
findings.resolution: Use async FFmpeg, timeout, capped bins, strong-identity cache and bounded concurrency.
Revalidate indexed SHA, provenance, license and supported slot at mutation time.

findings.resolution: Require a configured project root and realpath containment.
